net.canarymod.plugin

Interface PluginLifecycle

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    JavaPluginLifecycle, PluginLifecycleBase

    public interface PluginLifecycle
    Defines lifecycle methods for a plugin - load, enable, disable. Implemented by individual PluginManagers
